party.role: bulky grass spread damage and emergency Confide
Flying Fighting counter; Aerial Ace priority target pressure
Protect scout and Bug Bite reserve; avoid Rollout lock-in unless forced
Electric immunity and Rock Tomb speed control
Ground spread reserve for Electric/Poison threats
Ground immunity to Electric, Bulldoze speed control, Ice Shard priority

target_priorities: Mienfoo first: Fighting pressure plus Helping Hand can amplify the opening turn; Aerial Ace is the verified super-effective line.
Aipom second: remove Fake Out/Aerial Ace pressure after the first turn.
Luxio and Flaaffy immediately when they enter: pivot a grounded attacker to Phanpy or Onix and use Ground damage; never leave Staravia exposed to Electric coverage.
Nidorina/Nidorino next: use non-contact Ground damage or safe spread pressure before Toxic/Venoshock compounds.
Preserve at least one full-health Ground reserve for the final Electric pair.
contingencies: If Aipom Fake Outs Staravia, continue the queued Grotle spread action; do not spend a turn repeating a no-op.
If Mienfoo survives, keep it the priority target unless the battle RAM shows an immediate guaranteed KO on Aipom; Helping Hand and Force Palm are the highest opening risk.
When Luxio or Flaaffy appears, switch the threatened grounded lead to Phanpy or Onix before taking Electric damage; Phanpy Bulldoze is safe beside Staravia because Flying is immune to Ground.
Use Bulldoze against Electric/Poison reserves only when the allied partner is Flying or otherwise verified safe; otherwise use Rock Tomb, Rock Throw, or a switch.
If Toxic or paralysis lands and no immediate KO is available, pivot to a full-health reserve rather than spending the next turn on a low-confidence attack.
If a predicted KO, speed order, target, or damage range disagrees with battle RAM, stop, record the mismatch, and re-evaluate from a fresh canonical snapshot before another input.

deterministic_evidence.source: verified ROM type chart plus current party RAM stats; integer-conservative damage bounds
opening: Staravia Aerial Ace (slot3) vs Mienfoo: 20-25 damage, super effective; Staravia speed36 vs Mienfoo speed29, so it is modeled first unless priority/AI changes the order.
Grotle Razor Leaf (slot1) vs Mienfoo: 11-14 damage; vs Aipom: 44-52 damage, modeled as a guaranteed Aipom KO from full HP if it connects and no protective effect intervenes.
Aipom speed36 ties Staravia and Fake Out has priority; this is the main opening uncertainty, not ignored.
Phanpy Bulldoze (slot1) vs Luxio: 16-20; vs Flaaffy: 14-18; vs Nidorina: 6-9. It also lowers enemy Speed and is safe beside Flying Staravia because Ground is immune to Flying.
Phanpy Ice Shard (slot0) vs Mienfoo: 3-5 and priority; preserve it for finishing a low-HP faster threat rather than opening damage.
material_uncertainty: Exact enemy target selection, Fake Out target, accuracy, critical hits, and damage rolls are resolved from battle RAM after each queued action.
Spread-move damage reduction and custom trainer AI are rechecked against the first live double-battle result before calling any KO forced.

other: Enemy target selection and damage random rolls are not forced before battle; read each command/action result from battle RAM and text.
The current party order is preserved because a RAM-verified party reorder primitive is not yet available; the plan explicitly uses Grotle/Staravia as the opening pair and Phanpy/Onix as reserves.
